new_string: # After 1.Kg6, a depth-2 search from the child must see the forced mate
# (...Kg8 2.Qd8# lands exactly on the depth-0 horizon).
child = apply_move(board, next(m for m in legal_moves(board) if m.to_uci() == "f6g6"))
score, _ = negamax(child, 2, -_INF, _INF)  # black to move, forced ...Kg8, then Qd8#
old_string: # One ply before the mate, a depth-1 search must see MATE_SCORE.
child = apply_move(board, next(m for m in legal_moves(board) if m.to_uci() == "f6g6"))
score, _ = negamax(child, 1, -_INF, _INF)  # black to move, forced ...Kg8, then Qd8#
